purpose: Local synthetic data that drives the replaceable track-C web shell first phase (task list/detail, timeline, info completion, approval card display, citations, retry and error panels). Shapes align with the apps/api Task/Command/Event v1 contracts and the stream.py SSE frame format. All digests are fictional and never derived from real credentials.

tasks.v1.json.note: Task v1 projections; every entry must also parse as apps/api TaskBody and flowpilot_domain.Task

events.v1.json.note: TaskEvent v1 envelopes delivered over SSE; task_002 deliberately carries a sequence gap (3) to exercise gap detection

approvals.v1.json.note: Approval records rendered by the approval card; join key action_id -> planned-actions.v1.json

planned-actions.v1.json.note: Planned actions rendered as card impact/parameters/rationale/summary/expiry; twin actions under task_004 mirror the M5-1 composite shape

result-artifacts.v1.json.note: Result artifact display data (content + citations) referenced by task.result_ref; citations mirror ResultCitation semantics

commands.v1.json.note: Command drafts the shell builds for info completion (task.message.submit.v1) and retry (task.retry.request.v1); no approval commands
